name: fountain-pen-signature
title: Fountain Pen Signature
description: A cursive signature drawn as an SVG stroke path with variable stroke width (two overlapping paths slightly offset), animating via dashoffset as if written by hand — sign here, then wipe and re-sign.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Humanist
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Button Redraw: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
